integrity: The proof reconstructs the stationary pair as a uniform split of a size-biased interval, decomposes covariance into a nonnegative common-scale term and a fixed negative split term, and proves both sharp endpoints analytically. Finite computation only replays integer-power cases.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns stationary renewal age and residual life and excludes finite-time transients.
The upper endpoint is a supremum rather than an attained maximum.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent result in older Schur-constant dependence literature.
title: Sharp unequal-power correlation range for stationary renewal age and residual life
